name: framecn
summary: Video components for React built on Editframe, distributed as shadcn registry items for building videos in code.
description: Open-source video components for React built on Editframe and distributed through a shadcn registry and CLI. Caption components (Clip Wipe, Glitch RGB, Matrix Decode, Pill Karaoke and more) animate text over video, WebGL shader backdrops from paper-design/shaders set the scene, and UI primitives like Button, Input, Dialog and chat pieces build app mockups inside compositions. Prebuilt compositions such as Product Launch Trailer, Browser Flow and AI Generation Canvas render to MP4 through Editframe's cloud rendering.
contains: 15+ caption effects: Clip Wipe, Glitch RGB, Matrix Decode, Pill Karaoke and more
prebuilt compositions: Product Launch Trailer, Browser Flow, AI Generation Canvas
WebGL shader backdrops adapted from paper-design/shaders
llms.txt, markdown mirrors and an agent skill for AI agents
